source.name: Trekly curated manufacturer specifications
source.terms_notes: Each record was checked by hand against the manufacturer's own public product page (source_url) on verified_at. Only factual specifications are recorded; no descriptions, marketing copy, logos or product photography are copied. Values not printed on the page are omitted, never estimated. Where a page lists both imperial and metric figures, the more precise one is used for the canonical value and the published text is kept verbatim in specs.published_weight.
